import os
import warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from xgboost import XGBClassifier

# Suppress warnings and progress bars
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv")
SAMPLE_SUB_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv")
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
SUBMISSION_PATH = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load Data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUB_PATH)

# Define target columns in required order
label_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]
y_labels = train_df[label_cols].values
X_text = train_df["comment_text"].values
ids_test = test_df["id"].values

# Split training data into train/val
X_train_text, X_val_text, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_text, y_labels, test_size=0.1, random_state=42, stratify=None
)

# Vectorize Text with improved TF-IDF parameters
print("Vectorizing text...")
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=20000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    min_df=1,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,  # Apply sublinear tf scaling to downweight frequent terms
)
X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_text)
X_val_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_val_text)

# Train Models (Independent Binary Classifiers)
print("Training models on validation split...")
models = []
for i in range(y_labels.shape[1]):
    model = XGBClassifier(
        n_estimators=150,
        max_depth=4,
        learning_rate=0.1,
        objective="binary:logistic",
        random_state=42,
        verbose=False,
        eval_metric="auc",
        use_label_encoder=False,
        n_jobs=-1,
    )
    model.fit(X_train_vec, y_train[:, i])
    models.append(model)

# Evaluate on Hold-out Validation Set
print("Evaluating on validation set...")
preds_val = np.zeros((X_val_vec.shape[0], y_labels.shape[1]))
for i, model in enumerate(models):
    preds_val[:, i] = model.predict_proba(X_val_vec)[:, 1]

auc_scores = []
for i in range(y_labels.shape[1]):
    if y_val[:, i].sum() > 0 and y_val[:, i].sum() < y_val[:, i].size:
        auc = roc_auc_score(y_val[:, i], preds_val[:, i])
        auc_scores.append(auc)
    else:
        auc_scores.append(0.5)  # Default if no variation

mean_auc = np.mean(auc_scores)
print(f"Validation AUC Scores: {auc_scores}")
print(f"Mean Validation ROC AUC: {mean_auc:.4f}")

# Retrain Final Model on Full Training Data
print("Training final model on full data...")
X_full_text = train_df["comment_text"].values
vectorizer_full = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=20000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=1, max_df=0.95, sublinear_tf=True
)
X_full_vec = vectorizer_full.fit_transform(X_full_text)

models_final = []
for i in range(y_labels.shape[1]):
    model = XGBClassifier(
        n_estimators=150,
        max_depth=4,
        learning_rate=0.1,
        objective="binary:logistic",
        random_state=42,
        verbose=False,
        use_label_encoder=False,
        n_jobs=-1,
    )
    model.fit(X_full_vec, y_labels[:, i])
    models_final.append(model)

# Predict on Test Set
print("Predicting on test set...")
X_test_text = test_df["comment_text"].values
X_test_vec = vectorizer_full.transform(X_test_text)

preds_test = np.zeros((X_test_vec.shape[0], y_labels.shape[1]))
for i, model in enumerate(models_final):
    preds_test[:, i] = model.predict_proba(X_test_vec)[:, 1]

# Create Submission
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(preds_test, columns=label_cols, index=ids_test)
submission_df.insert(0, "id", ids_test)
submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_PATH, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {SUBMISSION_PATH}")
